protocol.grouping_rule: dyadic block commutativity: two words share a setting iff their restrictions commute inside every contiguous k-qubit block
protocol.block_size_note: k is clamped to the arm's measured qubit count, so a +2q arm at n=6 records k=6 rather than k=8; rungs at different n are not comparable on qubit count
protocol.synthesis: block-local Clifford diagonalizer, cheapest Z-preserving coset representative per output qubit, one-qubit runs reduced to shortest words over {H, S, S_DAG}

cost_layer.note: the accuracy-matched layer runs a subset of the structural grid; run_protocol_cost.py reads its scope here so that a system's presence in the structural grid never silently commits the exact-tier search to it

deferred.reason: the exact-tier shot search does not resolve this bank's crossings inside the declared endpoint grid. Its word universe is 7926 against BeH2's 1814 on the full-width arms and 2047 against 511 on the +2q arms, and four times the words to reconstruct from the same shots is four times the pencil variance, which moves the confirmed crossings from BeH2's 4096-16384 up to 16384-65536 -- against a grid whose last point is 65536. This is a deferral on resolution, not on accuracy: the bank clears the 1.6 mHa bias floor with room at 0.766 mHa, it is priced structurally in protocol_axis.json, and it is what makes QR3 eligible at the asymptotic tier in mapping_axis.json.
deferred.what_would_lift_it: endpoints above 65536, which SEARCH_ENDPOINTS pins and exact_shot_search.json shares, so lifting it rebuilds R1's record too and is a change to both layers rather than a scope change to this one

scoping_probe.note: a reduced-replica probe run to fix this scope decision. It is not evidence for any cost and no number here may be quoted as one; the headline replica counts this record requires are 30 and 100.

claim_boundary: group counts, coverage, and synthesis resources under a declared card at uniform shots; not an accuracy-matched C(epsilon), which R1's exact-tier shot search prices separately and which the h4 budget-8 bank does not clear
